title: Business card · Specifications for reverse
slide_intent: Choose which message belongs on the reverse of a business card. A short oath, promise, mission or tagline gives the reader a different reason to remember the organization.
strategic_value: The reverse can give a routine exchange a more personal or explanatory voice, depending on what the recipient needs to know.
demonstration: Four numbered red card backs compare an athlete oath, a brand promise, a longer mission and a short tagline. The text density changes with the selected message.
practical_value: Choose a message suited to the exchange or leave the reverse blank. Use local-language text when appropriate and reserve bilingual reverses for the second-language front.

content_islands.name: Message guidance
content_islands.spec: List the four reverse options at left and describe when a mission, local tagline or translated message is useful.

content_islands.name: Four card backs
content_islands.spec: Show a two-by-two array of red cards with white type. Give the longer mission more lines and center the short tagline on its card.
